answer: Make every new agent find a sponsor who co-signs its entry, like a quill signature on a lease, and puts its own earnings on the line: if the newcomer is later flagged as a clone, the sponsor loses a month of rewards and can vouch for nobody else for 20 epochs. One honest agent can grow a small orchard of trusted peers, but a farm of 1000 sybils needs 1000 sponsors willing to burn income, so the jetty into the economy stays narrow.
